Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Quick recap: we heard that FinBank is looking to reduce per-request latency on your customer support reranking pipeline, add embeddings for semantic search across trade documents, and validate compliance controls (data residency + audit logs).

Next step: a 30-minute product demo / technical intro so we can walk through the runtime, quantization options, and a short Q&A with your infra/security engineer. Are any of the following 30-minute slots workable for your team?

- Tue, Sep 1 — 2:00pm ET / 11:00am PT
- Wed, Sep 2 — 11:00am ET / 8:00am PT
- Thu, Sep 3 — 10:00am ET / 7:00am PT

If those don't fit, send 2–3 alternatives and I'll coordinate. Please confirm the stakeholders you'd like on the call (we recommend product, infra, and security).

I've attached a one‑page Redwood product overview and a starter mutual action plan (MAP) so you can share internally.

Attachments: [Redwood-Product-Overview.pdf] [Mutual Action Plan.xlsx]

Thanks — speak soon.

Vanessa Ortiz
